units.source_text: 对弈者一落座，首先将棋盘上的棋盒放在自己膝前。

en.t: As soon as the players sat down, each first placed the go-stone box from the board in front of his own knees.

units.source_text: 对名人来说，这棋盒很沉重。

en.t: For the Master, this go-stone box was very heavy.

units.source_text: 之后，两人铺展出棋局大势，直到棋赛中断。

en.t: After that, the two players unfolded the broad shape of the game until the match was suspended.

units.source_text: 总之，两人有秩序地你追我赶地下下去。

en.t: In short, the two continued playing in orderly pursuit of one another, each pressing and answering the other.

units.source_text: 起初名人的棋子好像要从指尖落下来似的。

en.t: At first, the Master's stones seemed as if they were about to slip down from his fingertips.

units.source_text: 随着棋局的进展，越下越有力，放棋子的声音也越来越高了。

en.t: As the game progressed, his play grew more and more forceful, and the sound of placing the stones grew louder as well.
